data.name: One-on-One Individual Surf Lesson
data.headline: Surf lessons on Waikīkī Beach, directly in front of The Royal Hawaiian hotel
data.description: Learn to surf with a private one-on-one lesson from a lifeguard certified Waikīkī Beachboy. Perfect for beginners, this 1.25-hour lesson includes 15 minutes of safety instruction on the sand followed by in-water surfing time.
data.highlights:
- Private one-on-one surf lesson with a certified instructor
- Perfect for beginners and kids under 12 years of age
- All instructors are lifeguard and CPR certified
- Learn to surf on Waikīkī Beach, the birthplace of surfing
data.itinerary:
- 15 minutes of safety instruction on the sand
- 1 hour of in-water surfing with a private instructor

meeting_point.address: Royal Hawaiian Hotel, 2259 Kalākaua Ave., Honolulu, HI 96815

data.what_is_included:
- Surfboard
- Rash guard rental during the lesson
- 15-minute safety briefing and land lesson before heading into the water.
data.cancellation_summary: Submit cancellation requests 48 hours prior to activity for a refund.
data.cancellation_notes:
If you wish to change or cancel your booking, please submit your request via e-mail to info@waikikibeachservices.com at least 48 hours before an activity/rental. No-shows or cancellation requests received within 48 hours will not be eligible for refund.

Please allow up to 10 business days for refunds to process between banking institutions.
data.booking_notes:

#ALOHA,

Mahalo for booking with **Waikīkī Beach Services at the Royal Hawaiian**. Please read below important information.

#Check-In

Please check-in at least 10–15 minutes before your booked time at our service counter located on the pool deck of the Royal Hawaiian Hotel at 2259 Kalākaua Ave., Honolulu, HI. 96815.  

Find your way to the beach by taking the surfboard lined public beach access walkway that is located between The Cheesecake Factory (restaurant) and The Outrigger Waikiki on the Beach (hotel) on Kalakaua Ave. Continue down this path until you have reached the sand. Our service counter is located on your right.

#Things to Remember

Please bring your own towel and sunscreen and leave valuables at home. Please note that personal belongings should not be left unattended at any time on the beach or pool. Bringing money or non-essential personal belongings to the beach or pool is highly discouraged. The pool and beach staff is not responsible for guests' personal belongings. 


All guests must e-fill the emailed Waiver Form prior to the activity and will have their temperature scanned before the activity date/time.

Should you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.

We look forward to seeing you.

Mahalo nui loa,

data.special_requirements:
- Participants must be able to swim and be comfortable being submerged under the water.
- Children under 12 years of age are required to take a private one-on-one lesson.
data.restrictions: - Pregnant women or guests with prior neck or back injuries may not participate in a surf lesson.
data.extras:
- Photos and video available for purchase
- All instructors are CPR and lifeguard certified.
data.health_and_safety_notes:
Your safety and the safety of our staff are our highest priorities. All participants, including minors, must complete an electronic liability waiver before participating in any Waikīkī Beach Services activity or rental. A link to the waiver will be included in your confirmation email. We recommend completing all waivers before your scheduled activity to help expedite check-in.

Some activities and rentals have minimum age requirements. Please provide accurate participant ages when booking. Guests who do not meet the age requirement or appear to be under the influence of drugs or alcohol will not be permitted to participate, and no refund will be issued.

Please do not leave personal belongings unattended on the beach or at the pool. Limited storage is available for shoes and towels, but valuables should be left in a secure location. Waikīkī Beach Services and its staff are not responsible for lost, stolen, or damaged personal property.
data.faqs:
- **Do I need prior surfing experience?**
No, our Waikīkī Beach surf lessons are perfect for beginners. We can tailor your lesson to meet your surf level.
- **Are children allowed to participate?**
Yes. Children under the age of 12 must take a One-on-one Individual lesson for safety reasons..
- **We have more than one child under 12 and wish to book them all at the same time slot.  I have booked them on different times. Can you modify for us?**
If you have already made your bookings, please email us with all the booking numbers to info@waikikibeachservices.com.  We will be happy to check the availability of our surf instructors and modify if we could.
-  **We have more than one child under 12 and wish to book them all at the same time slot, but we do not see availability online. Can you help?**
Please email us at info@waikikibeachservices.com with 1) The number of children and their ages 2) Preferred date and time of your lesson (choose three) 3) Your full contact information (email address & cell phone number). Once we have received your message, we will contact you within one business day. 
- **Can our family take surf lessons together if we have two children under 12?**
Yes, but you will need to make separate reservations. Each child age under 12 years of age must book a One-on-one Individual Surf Lesson with their own instructor. Adults and guests ages 12 and older may book an appropriate group lesson.
